hook: orphan 時間團在候車室：dally／dillydally／procrastination／anachronistic——鐘停了，大家還在說「再五分鐘」。
script: dally／dillydally 磨蹭。procrastination 拖延。anachronistic 時空錯置。doodle 塗鴉混時間。faddish 短暫流行。口令：鐘寫「發車了」，塗鴉寫「別再畫火車」。

members.senseAnchor: behave carelessly or indifferently; waste time
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 再五分: dally walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「再五分」出場：dally 一上場梗就黏住——磨蹭。

related.synonyms: toy, play, flirt, dawdle, butterfly, coquet

members.senseAnchor: postpone doing what one should be doing
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 雙重拖: dillydally walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「雙重拖」出場：dillydally 一上場梗就黏住——磨磨蹭蹭。

members.senseAnchor: the act of procrastinating; putting off or delaying or defering an action to a later time; slowness as a consequence of not getting around to it
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 待辦山: procrastination walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「待辦山」出場：procrastination 一上場梗就黏住——拖延。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 錯季帽: anachronistic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「錯季帽」出場：anachronistic 一上場梗就黏住——時代錯置的。

members.senseAnchor: an aimless drawing; make a doodle; draw aimlessly
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 塗鴉本: doodle walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「塗鴉本」出場：doodle 一上場梗就黏住——塗鴉。

members.senseAnchor: intensely fashionable for a short time
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 快閃潮: faddish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「快閃潮」出場：faddish 一上場梗就黏住——流行短暫的。

members.senseAnchor: be about; act foolishly, as by talking nonsense
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 發呆椅: footle walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「發呆椅」出場：footle 一上場梗就黏住——閒混。

related.synonyms: loiter, lounge, lollygag, loaf, lallygag, tarry

members.speakLineZh: 請「紅印」出場：overdue 一上場梗就黏住——逾期的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鐘: clock walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鐘」出場：clock 一上場梗就黏住——鐘。
